title: Supply-Chain Knowledge Map — blank template
purpose: Add one bounded graph only when an already broad starting point needs a clearer reader, operating object, decision, boundary, or evidence route. This template is not a request to build a taxonomy.
notes: A source_backed branch needs every selected source to carry a complete source_capsule: source_locator, accessed_on, supported_paraphrase and a local evidence_note_path. If that evidence is incomplete, keep the branch evidence_status=research_seed. The selector always leaves build_ready=false. This map can only hand off a bounded scope to Creative Opportunity Selection; it cannot approve a topic, claim, visual, or publication.
